title: Mango-Avocado Salsa
description: Fresh mango and avocado with lime, jalapeño, and cilantro. Works as a sauce, topping, or standalone side. Especially good with crab cakes and grilled fish.

instructions.text: Dice {0} mango and {1} avocado into roughly equal small pieces (about ½ inch). Finely dice {2} red onion and {3} jalapeño.
Combine mango, red onion, jalapeño, {4} cilantro, {5} lime juice, and the zest of {6} lime in a bowl. Toss gently.
Add avocado last and fold in carefully so it stays in chunks rather than turning to mash.
Season with {7} salt and {8} black pepper. Taste and adjust lime juice or salt. Serve immediately or within an hour — avocado oxidizes quickly.

notes: Add the avocado last and right before serving. If making ahead, prep everything else and fold in the avocado at the last minute. A squeeze of extra lime juice over the top slows oxidation if you need it to sit. Leave the jalapeño seeds in if you want more heat. No cilantro? Flat-leaf parsley works in a pinch but changes the flavor profile considerably.
